hero.headline: Different goals. One platform built for service providers.
hero.subheadline: Some partners want to bundle. Some need to differentiate. Others want to reduce churn, add AI, protect their brand, or outsource the entire channel motion. This page shows how one platform supports all of those outcomes.

sections.headline: The right bundle sells the product. The right products make the bundle multiply.
sections.body:
Service providers are shifting from standalone products to bundled subscriptions because both SMBs and providers benefit from simplicity and packaged value.

Hostopia is built for that model:

- Modular products that naturally combine (domains, email, websites, SEO, listings, reputation, ecommerce)
- Bundles you can align to your existing offers and tiers
- Simple starting points and clear upgrade paths

Examples of how partners use it:

- Telcos/ISPs: from basic digital identity to full digital commerce bundles
- Registrars: attach email, site, and marketing tools directly at checkout
- MSPs/hosting: extend “we manage your IT” into “we manage your online presence”

sections.headline: When everyone matches your speed and price, you need a different story.
sections.body:
Connectivity, domains, and basic hosting are easy to copy. Competing only on performance or discounting pushes you into the same box as every other provider.

Hostopia helps you reposition:

- From “utility provider” to “digital business partner”
- From “internet only” to “internet + online presence + growth tools”
- From commodity offers to value-led bundles that are harder to compare

With this shift, your pitch becomes less about a faster line and more about helping SMBs get online, get found, and grow through your branded platform.

image.alt: Laptop showing a white-label platform dashboard for provisioning, billing, and support

sections.headline: Connectivity is easy to cancel. A business's digital engine is not.
sections.body:
A single-product relationship is easy to walk away from. A relationship built around a business's online presence is much harder to unwind.

Hostopia adds layers of stickiness:

- Directory listings and local SEO that power how customers find the business
- Reputation and review management that build public proof over time
- Website and analytics that connect traffic to real outcomes

When these services sit with you, switching providers means more than changing a plan. It means rebuilding their marketing engine, which naturally supports retention and deeper engagement.

sections.eyebrow: AI in your portfolio, without building an AI team
sections.headline: Bring AI-powered services to market under your own brand.
sections.body:
SMBs are hearing about AI everywhere, but they need simple, guided products — not tools they have to figure out themselves. Most providers don't have the in-house capacity to build that.

Hostopia embeds AI into the services you offer:

- AI-assisted logo and brand creation for fast, professional identity
- AI-generated websites from just a business name and category
- Guided, AI-supported SEO that turns complex tasks into simple steps
- AI-enhanced migration tools to move accounts with less effort and risk

You get modern, AI-powered products in your catalog, fully branded as yours, without staffing a data science or AI engineering team.

sections.eyebrow: Control over brand, pricing, and experience
sections.headline: Your brand. Your commercial model. Your customer.
sections.body:
For service providers, “white-label” is about control, not just cosmetics. You need to own the brand, the economics, and the relationship.

Hostopia is designed for that:

- 100% white-label interfaces, dashboards, and support flows
- Multi-language, cloud-based delivery to support multiple regions
- You decide pricing, packaging, and promotions across your offers

We provide the platform, provisioning, and optional billing capabilities; you decide how it shows up in-market and how revenue is structured.

sections.headline: You don't just get software. You get a team that can run the motion with you.
sections.body:
Launching digital services at scale takes more than technology. It requires GTM, operations, and ongoing support that many providers don't want to build from scratch.

Hostopia can act as an extension of your organization:

- Partner marketing support, assets, and campaigns in your brand
- Channel programs that help you stand up and run a sales motion
- Project and service management to launch, migrate, and optimize
- Fully white-labeled support across channels and tiers

You can choose the level of support you want — from “we run it ourselves” to “we rely on Hostopia to operate the entire channel under our brand.”

cta.body: Whether your priority is bundling, differentiation, retention, AI, brand control, or operating the whole channel, Hostopia is built for service providers like you.
